conditions: User must provide consent before collecting personal data.
User must be provided with information about data collection practices.
effects: Sets whether the user has consented to data collection, affecting whether personal data is collected and sent to the server.
If consent is set to false, no personal data will be collected or sent to the server.

conditions: User agrees to allow data collection.
effects: Personal data will be collected and sent to the server if the user consents.
User consented to data collection.
Enables the collection of personal data

conditions: User does not agree to allow data collection.
effects: Disables the collection of personal data
No personal data will be collected or sent to the server if the user does not consent.
User does not consent to data collection.

conditions: User must be known to be in an age-restricted category (e.g., under the age of 16).
effects: Sets a flag that indicates that the user is in an age-restricted category.
Indicates whether the user is in an age-restricted category, specifically for users under the age of 16.

conditions: User is confirmed to be under the age of 16.
effects: Triggers age-restriction related data handling practices.
Indicates the user has age restrictions in place
User is recognized as an age-restricted individual and thus may limit data collection or utilization.

conditions: User is 16 years of age or older.
effects: Indicates that the user is not in an age-restricted category.
No age-restriction related data handling practices applied.

conditions: User must provide consent for data collection under CCPA compliance.
Applicable U.S. privacy laws require user consent for data collection.
effects: Sets the user's consent status for the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).
If consent is set to false, no personal data will be collected or sent to the server.
Sets whether the user has consented to the sale of their personal information under CCPA

conditions: User opts in to allow personal data collection for CCPA compliance.
effects: Enables the sale of personal information
Personal data may be collected and shared according to CCPA.
User consents to the sale of personal information under CCPA.

conditions: User opts out of allowing personal data collection for CCPA compliance.
effects: Disables the sale of personal information
No personal data will be collected or shared under CCPA.
User does not consent to the sale of personal information under CCPA.
